_readme: Hosting + branding settings. appPath is the private path of the full app: keep it stable (customers bookmark it) and never link it publicly. Brand files are made by node scripts/make-logo.mjs; the paths below point at them.

startHere._readme: Start-Here PDF settings. npm run package makes both Start-Here-Letter.pdf and Start-Here-A4.pdf. Leave a screenshot path empty to use the drawn illustration; set it to a PNG to use a real device screenshot instead.
